content: Řḥukm x řegnus di teɣzurt n Yahucafaṭ
“Maɣar, xzar, deg wussan nni u di řweqt nni, xmi ɣa ssenqeřbeɣ tameḥbast n Yahuda d Urcalim,
ad ssmuneɣ marra řegnus, ad ten nedheɣ ɣar Teɣzurt n Yahucafaṭ. Dinni ad akidsen mcarraɛeɣ minzi nitni zuzzaren řgens inu d tesɣart inu jar řegnus u minzi nitni bḍan tammurt inu.
Nitni ggin taqedduḥt x řgens inu u wcin ijj n weḥram d ttexřiṣet i temɣart n farq-ccɣeř u ict n teḥramt temmenz i binu, ḥima nitni zemmaren ad swen.
U ɛawed, min ɣarwem akidi, Ṣur d Ṣidun d marra jjwayeh n Filicit. Ma texsem ad ayi txeǧṣem min ggiɣ? Mařa texsem ad ayi txeǧṣem, Necc ad ssɛeqbeɣ deɣya u s tazřa min teggim x izeǧifen nwem,
minzi kenniw tekksim nnuqart d wureɣ inu u minzi kenniw tiwyem řeqcuɛ inu yiɣřan ɣar tzawiyyin nwem.
Kenniw tᵉzzenzem iḥenjiren n Yahuda d iḥenjiren n Urcalim i iḥenjiren n Yawan, ḥima ad ten tessiggʷejem x temmurt nsen.
Xzar, Necc ad ten ssekkareɣ zeg wemcan mani ten tezzenzem u ad ssɛeqbeɣ min teggim x izeǧifen nwem.
Ad zzenzeɣ iḥenjiren nwem d yessitwem deg ufus n iḥenjiren n Yahuda u yina ad ten zzenzen i Isaba’iyyen, ijj n řgens iggʷej aṭṭas, maɣar SIDI aqa issiweř.”
“Řaɣam aya jar řegnus, qeddsem amenɣi, sekkarem ayt n bu-teɣruḍt, jjem marra iɛeskariyyen ad dd-qarrben, ad geɛɛden i umenɣi.
Ḥeddem dduzan nwem d řesyuf uřa d řemwas nwem n wezbar ař ɣa dewřen d fřitcat, ejj wenni iḍeɛfen ad yini: ‘Necc d bu-teɣruḍt!’
Azzřem u tasem-dd, a marra řegnus i dd-innḍen. Sneddeh ɣar dinni, a SIDI, ayt nnec n bu-teɣruḍt!
Jjem řegnus ad kkaren ad geɛɛden ɣar Teɣzurt n Yahucafaṭ. Maɣar dinni ad qqimeɣ Necc ḥima ad carrɛeɣ marra řegnus i-dd-innḍen.
Ggem amjar dayes, maɣar ṣṣabet tenngʷa, asem-dd, hwam, minzi tasirt n uḍiř teccur u ṣṣwarej n tsirt feyyḍen, maɣar taɛeffant nsen d tameqqrant.”
“Ibarruten, ibarruten di Teɣzurt n Teřwiḥt Itteḥruǧuḍen n Usarwet, maɣar ass n SIDI yudes, di Teɣzurt n Teřwiḥt Itteḥruǧuḍen i Usarwet.
Tafuct d tziri bbarcnent, itran arrin tafawt nsen.
SIDI ad izehhar zi Ṣihyun u ad yarr tmijja nnes ad ittwaseř zi Urcalim ařami ijenwan d temmurt ad arjijen, maca SIDI d adurri i řgens nnes d lburj i ayt n Israil.”
“Ad tessnem, aqa Necc d SIDI, AREBBI nwem, wenni izeddɣen x Ṣihyun, adrar inu iqeddsen u tandint n Urcalim ad tiři tqeddes. Ɛemmarṣ ad tt cuqen ɛad ibarraniyyen.”

“Deg wass nni ad imsar aqa idurar ad udmen s binu ẓemmen t jdid u tiwririn ad ssefyent s uɣi d marra tiɣezratin n Yahuda ad daysen ttazzřen waman u yict n tařa ad tedduqqez di Taddart n SIDI, ad tfeyyeḍ teɣzurt n Ciṭṭim.
Miṣra ad tedweř d ict n temmurt ittwareddǧen u Idum d ict n temmurt ixřan zi ssibbet n lɛunf i ggin ḍidd i ayt n Yahuda nni zi ssizzřen nitni idammen imezdagen di temmurt nsen.
Tammurt n Yahuda maca ad teqqim i řebda u Urcalim zi jjiř ař jjiř.
Necc ad ḥesbeɣ idammen nsen, inni tyɣa ḥessabeɣ war izdigen, d imezdagen. Uca SIDI ad izdeɣ di Ṣihyun.”
